tools.name: web_extract
tools.description: Extract structured data from web pages. Send 1-10 URLs and a JSON Schema describing the data shape you want. Returns extracted data for each URL. Costs $0.01 USDC per URL via x402 or MPP.

urls.description: URLs to extract data from (http/https only)

schema.description: JSON Schema with type "object" and properties describing desired output shape
